title: Ombelle project lock (ui-library.lock.json)
description: Provenance of every file and declaration Ombelle manages. Commit it. lockVersion 1 is the 1.0 format; fields added since 0.1 (edition, placements, presetSource, componentPresets, componentPresetSources, recipes, recipeSources) are optional, so older locks stay valid. A higher lockVersion is refused as written by a newer CLI.

logicalPath.description: The catalog path, independent of where the project placed the file.

sha256.description: The bytes Ombelle wrote (LF line endings). A file whose bytes differ was edited after install.

scopedRow.description: A recipe or component-preset install: its compile identity (recompiled and compared on every run) and the files it owns.

placements.description: Components installed beside an app-owned file, under <components>/ombelle/.

presetSource.description: The ps_ code the saved preset came from; see snapshot-source.schema.json.

managedDeclarations.description: Theme declarations Ombelle wrote into the global stylesheet, with the value it wrote.
